newsitem.title: CHINA: China First Pencil buys rival.
newsitem.headline: China First Pencil buys rival.

text.p: Shanghai-based China First Pencil Co Ltd has taken over a local state-run competitor for 8.40 million yuan ($1.01 million), the China Securities newspaper said on Tuesday.
The purchase of the Shanghai Expand Industry & Commerce Co, an enterprise under the Shanghai Light Industry Holdings (Group) Co, followed an agreement signed in April, the newspaper said.
The takeover had been approved by the Shanghai bureau of the National Administration of State Property, it added.
Shanghai Expand, a maker of pencils and pens, had total assets of 22.629 million yuan against total liabilities of 14.294 million yuan, the newspaper said.

But a total of 9.583 million yuan in subsidies, employee medical fees and costs for the re-employment of surplus workers was deducted from the total purchase price, meaning First Pencil did not have to pay cash for the acquisition at this stage.
